articles.title: Does marriage give you a share in your spouse’s property? FAQ on ownership rights
articles.description: Marriage alone does not automatically confer ownership of property titled only in one spouse's name. Financial contributions and co-borrowing can influence potential claims to the property. In cases of divorce, the separation does not grant property ownership to the non-owner spouse. Rights to live in a home may exist without ownership, depending on applicable laws. Inheritance laws dictate property distribution upon the owner's death, highlighting complex legal considerations.
